create_GlobalConfig: create a GlobalConfig instance with default bfloat16 set to all and flash attention using triton
review_GlobalConfig_bfloat16: review the GlobalConfig bfloat16 field which accepts all, none, or intermediate precision modes
review_GlobalConfig_flash_attention: review the GlobalConfig flash_attention_implementation field which selects triton or xla attention backends
review_GlobalConfig_pair_attention_chunk: review the GlobalConfig pair_attention_chunk_size field which defines 2D chunking tuples for pair attention
review_GlobalConfig_pair_transition_shar: review the GlobalConfig pair_transition_shard_spec field which defines 2D sharding tuples for pair transitions
